core_meaning.primary_meaning: Dawid is a Hebrew-origin name meaning “An. The source record”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Hebrew word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Dawid corresponds to the Hebrew form داود (Hebrew דָּוִד). Its core sense is given by god, gift of god. Dāwūd, the Arabic form of Hebrew David, a prophet named in the Qur'an. The source record's gloss 'Given by God' is an approximation.
